column3: Exact reprise of al-'ijl after Musa and clear signs; establishes the core wrongdoing.

Musa rejects seeking another god despite divine favor, sharpening the later substitution's incoherence.
Sets Musa's absence, Harun's succession, and the prohibition on corruption before the calf event.
